lines.1: 「I'll take some green onions and asparagus. Oh, and komatsuna and celery too.」
lines.3: 「You know, ma'am, you're looking even more radiant than usual today.」
lines.4: 「If I'd been born ten years earlier, I'd be trying my damnedest to sweep you off your feet.」
lines.5: 「Flattery or not, I'm happy to hear it. I'll throw in a pear for free.」
lines.6: 「Shopping's always best when you're on shift.」
lines.10: They each had a shopping bag dangling from one hand.
lines.11: 「We're a couple of housewives, aren't we?」
lines.12: 「The sad fate of those of us who cook for ourselves.」
lines.13: 「You moved here from the country and live on your own, right?」
lines.15: 「Well, if you ever get lonely, just say the word. I'll dispatch Leo or Crab to keep you company.」
